tier_0_personal.description: Personal facts about the NPC themselves — only this NPC knows these.

tier_1_local.description: Facts known to anyone living at St. Damson's institute — daily routines, who's friends with whom, what's served at meals.
facts: St. Damson's training day begins at sunrise with a horn from the gate tower.
The midday meal is taken in the Great Hall; instructors and squires eat at separate tables.
Knight-Instructor Marek favours a longsword in single combat but teaches the spear to initiates first.

tier_2_regional.description: Facts known across the local barony — village affairs, recent travelers, regional politics.
facts: The barony of Aethelford has been at peace for three years following the death of Baron Cedric.
A travelling merchant from the Free Cities passes through every spring carrying news from the south.
The road to the western coast is unsafe after dark due to brigands operating from the Greywood.

tier_3_national.description: Facts known to educated people across the kingdom — court politics, royal succession, major military movements.
facts: King Aldred III sits the Iron Throne; his only heir is Princess Elara, recently betrothed to a foreign prince.
The Knight-Commander of the realm is Sir Halric of the Vale, who took the office after the Conclave of Stormhold.
Tensions with the eastern kingdom of Vethros have escalated; envoys were recalled in late winter.

tier_4_scholarly.description: Facts known only to scholars, senior knights, or those with formal education in lore — historical events, theological doctrine, ancient agreements.
facts: The Concord of Aethelmere (year 412) bound the Kingdom and the Free Cities to mutual non-aggression for a hundred years; it expires in two years.
The Order of St. Damson was founded after the Battle of Hollowfen, when the saint himself defended a hundred orphans from a routing army.
Theological doctrine holds that the seven knightly virtues mirror the seven aspects of the divine; this is contested by the eastern Vethrosi tradition.
